# exo_calendar_settings (Resource)

Manages the CalendarSettings configuration via Set-CalendarSettings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `enable_preserve_declined_meetings` (String) Maps to the -EnablePreserveDeclinedMeetings parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
